import json
import os
import signal
import subprocess
import time
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path

from makemarket.provenance import file_sha256, receipt

root=Path('results/expansion')
raw=root/'raw/dice/meta_llama-3.2-90b-vision-instruct__text-only_.jsonl'
initial=raw.read_bytes()
path=root/'llama_mistral_priority.json'
assert not path.exists()
record={'provenance':receipt({'purpose':'finish the queued bounded Mistral availability control before more slow Llama episodes'},'NIM immutable deployment revision not exposed'),
        'source':Path(__file__).read_text(),'status':'waiting_for_completed_llama_episode','supervisor_pid':58651,
        'initial_episodes':initial.count(b'\n'),'initial_prefix_sha256':file_sha256(raw),
        'reason':'All four original 200/game API baselines are complete. Llama-90B is responsive but its full additional cohort is slow; prioritize the already registered 16384-token Mistral availability control. No score or decoder change.',
        'resume_command':['bash','scripts/with_resource.sh','nim','.venv/bin/python','-u','scripts/expand_nim.py','--models','meta/llama-3.2-90b-vision-instruct','--protocol-file','protocol-llama90-resume.json']}
path.write_text(json.dumps(record,indent=2)+'\n')
while True:
    command=subprocess.run(['ps','-p','58651','-o','command='],capture_output=True,text=True).stdout
    if 'runs/nim_baseline_priority.py' not in command:
        record['status']='old_supervisor_finished_before_pause'
        break
    data=raw.read_bytes()
    if len(data)>len(initial) and data.endswith(b'\n'):
        assert data.startswith(initial)
        assert os.getpgid(58651)==58651
        os.killpg(58651,signal.SIGTERM)
        record.update(status='paused_awaiting_mistral_finish',paused_at=datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
                      completed_dice_episodes=data.count(b'\n'),raw_bytes=len(data),raw_sha256=file_sha256(raw),
                      signal='SIGTERM to our own verified process group after a complete episode',initial_prefix_preserved=True)
        baseline=root/'baseline_priority_plan.json'
        before=json.loads(baseline.read_text())
        record['baseline_priority_before_sha256']=file_sha256(baseline)
        before.update(status='paused_for_mistral_budget_control',replacement_plan=str(path),
                      llama90_partial_episodes=data.count(b'\n'),limitation='Llama cohort is incomplete and unscored; resume the identical cached request after the availability control if campaign budget permits.')
        baseline.write_text(json.dumps(before,indent=2)+'\n')
        break
    time.sleep(.1)
path.write_text(json.dumps(record,indent=2)+'\n')
print(record['status'],flush=True)
